additions.summary: [VS-E26] Dynamic Configuration, Loyalty and Metadata Governance
additions.actor: Platform administrator, customer, host and service owner
additions.outcome: Typed domain-owned configuration evolves without hard-coded business variants or arbitrary runtime scripts.
additions.context: Authorization v2 supplies dynamic role policy. This epic applies the same versioned, maker-checker governance to loyalty tiers, property metadata, booking policy and operational analytics.
inScope: Publish versioned loyalty tiers and compute customer tier projections from qualifying points.
Publish typed property attributes and render them in Admin and Host without adding schema columns for each criterion.
Resolve effective booking policy by authoritative partition and freeze evaluated evidence with reservation decisions.
Expose permission-governed Admin operational analytics and rollout evidence.
outOfScope: Arbitrary scripts or expressions executed from stored configuration.
Client-selected authorization scope or direct cross-service database reads.
Retroactive mutation of published policy, tier, attribute or booking evidence.
businessRules: Each domain service is the only writer and source of truth for its configuration.
Published versions are immutable; corrections use a new version, retirement or compensating record.
Loyalty qualifying points are neither a Finance trust score nor a redeemable wallet.
Runtime rules are typed and allow-listed; no arbitrary expression or script is stored or executed.
interfaces: Version GraphQL, gRPC, event and JSON-schema contracts before consumer implementation.
Configuration writes require expected version, idempotency key, maker-checker audit and transactional outbox.
Read projections filter fields and partitions at the owning service before returning data.
dataOwnership: User owns loyalty programs and customer loyalty projection; Property owns attribute definitions and property values; Booking owns booking policy resolution and frozen booking evidence.
stateMachine: Configuration changes move through DRAFT, PENDING_APPROVAL, APPROVED or REJECTED; approved versions may later be RETIRED.
The requester cannot approve the same change and every transition records actor, reason and expected version.
Published versions remain immutable and replay-safe.

dataPartitions: SELF, OWN, ASSIGNED, PARTITION and ALL are enforced by the owning domain using authoritative membership data.
fieldGroups: Summary is default; sensitive booking commercial fields continue to require booking-sensitive:read.

failureSemantics: Return stable validation, forbidden, conflict, stale-version, dependency-unavailable and idempotency-conflict codes.
Fail closed when authorization or authoritative partition data is unavailable.
Never broaden access or silently fall back to a default policy after an invalid published version.
idempotencyConcurrency: Every retried mutation uses a scoped idempotency key and canonical request fingerprint.
Approval and publication use compare-and-swap against the expected configuration version.
Event consumers deduplicate by event ID and aggregate version.

acceptanceCriteria.given: an authorized maker and a valid typed change
acceptanceCriteria.when: a different authorized checker approves it
acceptanceCriteria.then: one immutable version is published with audit and outbox evidence

acceptanceCriteria.given: a stale version, replay mismatch or unauthorized partition
acceptanceCriteria.then: it fails with a stable code and no partial business effect
the owning service records the exact evaluated version and deterministic result

tests: Unit tests cover typing, effective dates, version transitions and protected invariants.
Integration tests cover maker-checker, CAS, idempotency, partition filtering and outbox replay.
Postman/Newman covers create, propose, approve, consume, reject and rollback-safe flows.
observability: Emit bounded metrics for publication, rejection, stale version, fallback prevention and reconciliation mismatch.
Propagate correlation IDs without logging secrets, PII or sensitive commercial fields.
Provide dashboards and runbooks for stuck requests and projection drift.
definitionOfDone: Catalog validation and affected repository CI checks pass.
Contracts, migrations, compatibility path, Admin Web/Mobile parity and Newman evidence are merged.
Authorization-negative, replay, reconciliation and rollback evidence is linked in Jira.
evidence: Pull request and commit links per repository.
Migration, rollback, audit and reconciliation artifacts.
additions.decisionNoteVi: Cấu hình động phải có kiểu, version và chủ sở hữu miền; không lưu hoặc chạy script tùy ý và không sửa ngược lịch sử đã publish.
activationBlockers: Docker/Testcontainers migration evidence and live Newman flows are not yet attached.

additions.summary: [VS-E26-S01] Dynamic loyalty tiers and qualifying-point projection
additions.outcome: Admins publish effective loyalty tier thresholds and customers receive a server-computed tier projection.
additions.context: The customer stores qualifying points; User Service resolves the active tier. Clients cannot assign their own tier.
inScope: Versioned tier thresholds and benefits metadata.
Replay-safe qualifying-point projection from booking completion.
Admin maker-checker and Customer SELF read.

dataPartitions: Customer reads SELF; administrators use approved ALL or organization policy.
fieldGroups: Qualifying points and tier only; no Finance trust detail or wallet balance.

activationBlockers: Booking-completed replay-safe consumer and Testcontainers/Newman evidence remain required.

additions.summary: [VS-E26-S02] Typed property attribute catalog and generated host form
additions.outcome: Property criteria beyond fixed invariants are published as typed definitions and rendered dynamically for hosts.
additions.context: Stable identity, ownership and location remain fixed fields; optional evolving criteria use typed definitions and validated values.
inScope: Typed attribute definition, validation and effective version.
Host form generated from authorized definitions.
Source-side PUBLIC, HOST and ADMIN field filtering.

dataPartitions: OWN host relationships and Admin PARTITION or ALL are verified from Property data.
fieldGroups: PUBLIC, HOST and ADMIN visibility is filtered at the source.

activationBlockers: Full authoring UI, query-plan evidence and live migration tests remain required.

additions.summary: [VS-E26-S03] Versioned booking policy resolution and immutable evidence
additions.actor: Booking policy administrator and booking actor
additions.outcome: Booking resolves effective policy deterministically and freezes evaluated policy evidence with each reservation decision.
additions.context: Booking policy is selected from authoritative property and branch data, never from a client-provided scope selector.
inScope: Effective policy lookup with PROPERTY, BRANCH, ORGANIZATION and GLOBAL precedence.
Immutable policy version and result stored with booking evidence.

dataPartitions: Resolution precedence is PROPERTY, BRANCH, ORGANIZATION, then GLOBAL; client input cannot select scope.
fieldGroups: Policy summary is readable separately from commercial booking data.

activationBlockers: Quote/hold/confirm wiring and live Testcontainers/Newman evidence remain required.

additions.summary: [VS-E26-S04] Dynamic configuration workspace, contracts and rollout evidence
additions.actor: Admin Web/Mobile operator and release owner
additions.outcome: Admin, customer and host surfaces consume validated versioned contracts with repeatable rollout evidence.
additions.context: All clients share domain APIs; Mobile does not introduce separate authorization or business endpoints.
inScope: Contract, migration, Newman and rollback evidence.

dataPartitions: Each UI receives only domain-authorized data; UI state never expands server scope.
fieldGroups: Catalog and checker queue fields are separated from sensitive customer and commercial data.

activationBlockers: Admin Mobile parity, Newman and zero-diff catalog synchronization remain required.

additions.outcome: Administrators see real, permission-governed operational and commercial statistics in Overview and a dedicated Analytics workspace.
additions.context: Analytics is a server-authorized projection over owned domain data; the frontend never synthesizes a broader partition.
inScope: Currency-safe revenue aggregation and permission-negative tests.

dataPartitions: Cross-property analytics requires ALL; narrower partition projections must be introduced explicitly.
fieldGroups: Revenue is aggregated separately by currency and never mixed into an invalid combined total.

activationBlockers: PR CI and live environment smoke evidence remain required.
